page.overview:
What is Angels of Retribution?

The Angels of Retribution is a now-extinct Codex Astartes-compliant, Loyalist Space Marine Chapter of unknown Founding and genetic origin.

The Adeptus Astartes and the agents of the Officio Assassinorum have never seen eye to eye, despite the fact that their ultimate goal is essentially the same. Because of the longstanding warrior traditions and codes of honour by which the Space Marines operate, the vast majority of Chapters see the Assassin's trade as distasteful at best.

Though the Officio's operatives have fought alongside the Space Marines on countless battlefields across the Imperium, there are several incidences in the history of the Adeptus Astartes where Assassins have been implicated as enemies rather than allies. The Officio Assassinorum is suspected in the involvement of the Angels of Retribution Chapter's demise. A strangely empty set of early-model power armour was discovered near the site of the ambush on the world of Alantor X, where the Angels of Retribution fell to a man.

The Angels of Retributon primarily wore grey power armour with black shoulder pauldrons. The trim of the shoulder pauldrons was also grey. The torso, groin and helm were red. The Aquila or Imperialis on the chest was black.
